title: Bank SMS phishing
summary: An urgent bank alert asks you to verify your account through an unexpected link.
warningSigns: Threats of immediate account suspension
An unfamiliar sender or link
Requests for passwords or OTPs
prevention: Open your bank’s official app yourself.
Call the number on your bank card or an independently verified official website.
nextSteps: Stop replying and save the message.
If you shared banking information, contact your bank immediately through its official channels.
keywords: sms kyc account suspended verification bank phishing otp

title: UPI refund requests
summary: Someone claims that approving a payment request will send a refund to your account.
warningSigns: A request to approve a debit to receive money
Pressure to enter your UPI PIN
An unexpected refund or unfamiliar payee
prevention: Read whether you are paying or receiving before approving anything.
Never enter a UPI PIN to receive an ordinary refund or incoming payment.
nextSteps: Decline unfamiliar requests and contact the provider through its official app.
If money was lost, contact your bank and report financial cyber fraud promptly on 1930.
keywords: collect refund pin payment request money receive

title: Fake job offers
summary: A guaranteed job comes with a demand for an upfront registration or training fee.
warningSigns: A job guaranteed without a credible hiring process
Pressure to pay immediately
An employer that cannot be independently verified
prevention: Find the employer’s official careers page independently.
Do not pay unsolicited recruiters to secure a promised job.
nextSteps: Keep the offer and payment references if any.
Contact the real employer using official details and report suspected fraud through official channels.
keywords: recruitment fee training registration employer work hiring

title: QR cashback tricks
summary: A QR code is presented as the way to claim a reward, but it can start an outgoing payment.
warningSigns: A reward that needs your PIN
An unfamiliar QR code or payee
A payment approval screen disguised as a claim step
prevention: Check the amount and recipient on the payment screen.
Do not scan an unfamiliar code or approve a debit to receive cashback.
nextSteps: If you approved a payment, contact your payment provider and bank promptly.
keywords: qr code cashback scan reward pin

title: Support impersonation
summary: Someone posing as customer support asks for a secret code or remote access.
warningSigns: A request for your OTP, PIN or password
An unsolicited support call
Instructions to install remote-access software
prevention: Keep OTPs, PINs and passwords private.
Use the support option inside the official app instead of a number in an unexpected message.
nextSteps: If you shared secrets or access, contact the provider, secure the account and inform your bank if payments are involved.
keywords: otp password customer care support remote access call

title: Lottery & prize scams
summary: An unexpected win requires a processing charge before your supposed prize is released.
warningSigns: A competition you never entered
Fees to unlock winnings
Pressure to keep the win secret or pay quickly
prevention: Do not send money for an unsolicited prize.
Verify the claim through the organisation’s independently located official website.
nextSteps: Stop contact and preserve the message.
Report financial loss promptly to your bank and official reporting channels.
keywords: lottery winner winnings prize processing fee reward

title: Fake delivery alerts
summary: A failed-parcel message asks you to update your address or pay a small fee through a link.
warningSigns: An unexpected delivery alert
A shortened or unfamiliar link
Requests for card details to release a parcel
prevention: Open the courier’s official app or website independently.
Check tracking against your own order history.
nextSteps: Do not reply or enter details through the message.
Contact your bank if you shared payment details or approved an unfamiliar payment.
keywords: parcel package courier address failed shopping delivery link

title: Malware & fake downloads
summary: Harmful software can be disguised as a parcel app, invoice or browser update.
warningSigns: Unexpected apps or executable attachments
Instructions to bypass security warnings
Permissions unrelated to the stated purpose
prevention: Use trusted app stores and official vendor update controls.
Keep protections enabled and verify unexpected attachments independently.
nextSteps: Stop interacting with the suspected file or app and seek trusted technical support.
Use a separate trusted device to secure important accounts if compromise is suspected; contact your bank if money is at risk.
keywords: apk virus malware ransomware executable attachment zip fake update permissions

title: Adware & scareware
summary: Intrusive advertising, misleading security popups and unwanted extensions can push unsafe installs.
warningSigns: In-page alerts claiming a full device scan
Pressure to download a cleaner
Extensions requesting excessive access or changing search settings
prevention: Close suspicious tabs using browser controls rather than buttons in the popup.
Review extension permissions and install only tools whose source and access are justified.
nextSteps: Review unwanted extensions and notification permissions in browser settings.
Use trusted security tools and qualified support if intrusive behaviour persists.
keywords: adware scareware popup extension cleaner notifications browser ads coupons
